components.name: Flexpa Health Wallet
components.description: A patient wallet built by Flexpa: US Core records, a CARIN insurance card, and PHQ-2 as a form. Renders questionnaires.
components.testPatient: Sam Okafor, born 1986, with problems, allergies, medications, immunizations, observations, and a CARIN insurance card
components.notes: Signed out, the wallet first asks you to simulate an IAL2 sign-in. Records you import stay in your browser.
